title: Knight's Diary
description: Knight's diary, the medieval diary look, treats the frame as an illuminated page that still has mud on it: gold leaf as light, iron texture, dirt on cloth, a tired face like a saint who has been outside. It is period matter, not a plastic castle fair.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Quest, confession, a modern person dressed by a medieval grade: gold in the highlights, chain or plate as texture, a shallow interior or a wet field. Agamemnon is antique sun on a king.
This is the book of the war. It is the wrong tool for clean LARP, shiny swords, and tourist battlements.
If there is no dirt and no gold, it is just the word medieval.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Eye height, 35mm to 50mm, lock-off. Gold leaf as highlight, not as a filter.
Hard or hard-soft daylight, mud on cloth, iron that has weight. One figure readable.
Avoid clean costume steel. Prompt: Knight's-diary image of [Subject], illuminated-manuscript gold, iron, mud, a page from a crusade.

sections.title: In film

blocks.text: The Green Knight puts mud, metal, and uncanny gold around a tired quester. A Knight's Tale still has quiet frames of iron and pageantry before the joke.
Page and mud together. Not a still to copy.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Knight's Diary in film?
A medieval matter recipe: illuminated gold, iron, mud, a living face on a crusade page. It is texture and light, not a castle establishing shot.
Knight's Diary vs Agamemnon
Agamemnon is bronze sun and a bruise sky. Knight's diary is gold leaf and mud, manuscript logic. Same hunger for antique metal, different page.
When should I use Knight's Diary?
Quest, confession, a period grade on a tired face. Skip clean LARP and shiny swords.
How do I prompt Knight's Diary for AI image or video?
Name iron, mud, and gold as light, then: Knight's-diary image of [Subject], illuminated-manuscript gold, iron, mud, a page from a crusade. Lock the camera. Keep one readable figure.
